shortDescription: This module allow to import beat dashboards into kibana

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The url used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: beats
options.description: This is a dict with key as names of the dashboards wich setup is performed The dict must be a dictionary with a namespaces name key containing a list where dashboard need to be imported

options.name: password
options.description: The password used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: ssl_verify
options.description: Choose to verify the ssl certificate or not

options.name: user
options.description: The user used to connect with elasticsearch service
